newsitem.title: USA: Inland confirms talks with USX.
newsitem.headline: Inland confirms talks with USX.

text.p: Inland Steel Industries Inc in a statement Monday confirmed it had had talks early last year with the U.S. Steel Group of USX Corp on the possible benefits of a combination of certain of steel manufacturing businesses.
But Inland said the talks ended in late 1996 when Inland concluded a combination would not be in the best interests of its stockholders and creditors.
A company spokesman declined to elaborate.
Inland said it continues to regularly evaluate strategic alternatives to improve shareholder value.
Prudential Securities analyst Ken Hoffman told Reuters news of the talks comes as no surprise. "The domestic steel industry must consolidate over the next five years. It's inevitable," Hoffman said.
Inland was up 3/8 at 19-1/4. USX was up 3/8 at 26-1/8. ((Reuters Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
